data.action: 双手扶剑柄将重剑直插雪地，热浪蒸腾，迎风伫立
data.camera: low angle, wide shot, 仰视全景，白雪茫茫中一抹绯红与升腾热汽
data.description: 风雪呼啸的萨米寒冷荒原上，积雪在狂风中飞旋。史尔特尔将那柄炽热的‘莱瓦汀’重剑直插雪地，剑锋散发的高温让周围的积雪瞬间融化沸腾，化作白色的蒸汽升腾而起。她迎着暮光伫立，金红双眸毫无动摇。
data.lighting: 风雪中地平线微弱的灰冷暮光与剑刃隐隐泛出的地火暗红
data.promptProse: Standing tall amidst a howling winter snowfield, Surtr plants her scorching greatsword blade-first into deep snowdrifts. Billowing steam rises as intense heat melts the ice around the weapon, set against bleak horizon dusk light and drifting snowflakes.
data.title: 史尔特尔 · 风雪荒原的灼热插剑
data.animaCaption: With her greatsword planted into the snow, steam billows around her as she stands unwavering in the freezing winter dusk.
